args.title: Fix password reset email links to use correct base URL
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Change the base URL used in the password reset email to not default to localhost. This fixes the issue where password reset emails sent to users contain links pointing to http://localhost:3000, which are inaccessible in production or other environments. The change ensures the URL correctly uses the PUBLIC_URL environment variable when set.
